candidate.rationale: Accepted icon is the obsolete standalone red Tesco T; the evidenced current Tesco Bank branding is the TESCO Bank lockup (red TESCO, blue Bank, blue underlines), verified against the official App Store listing. Original vector source recorded in the attempt.

transforms: Uniform scale 0.0556793 (whole emblem, no distortion) and translation to centre in a 54x54 viewBox with 2px side clearances; no other geometry or colour change.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Accepted icon is the obsolete standalone red T; current evidenced Tesco Bank branding is the TESCO Bank lockup, available as an original vector.

sources.observation: Official Tesco Bank App Store listing (fetched 2026-10-04) shows the current app icon: blue tile, white 'Bank', red TESCO with blue underlines. Raster used as research evidence only.

Original vector TESCO Bank lockup (red TESCO, blue Bank, blue underlines; Adobe Illustrator export) matching the current app icon branding. Other variants on the page are the obsolete red T or Tesco PLC wordmark.
Tesco PLC materials show the Tesco Bank logo as blue 'Bank' text and stripes with red TESCO.
